aboutGame.title: What is Squadron 42?
paragraphs: Squadron 42 is a cinematic single-player space combat game set in the Star Citizen universe. Players enlist in the UEE Navy and fight through a story-driven campaign featuring tactical dogfights, boarding actions, and large-scale fleet battles.

Developed by Cloud Imperium Games and led by Chris Roberts, Squadron 42 combines a star-studded cast, detailed spacecraft, and immersive sci-fi combat. Our wiki covers ships, missions, weapons, characters, and systems with detailed guides and walkthroughs.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Squadron 42.

items.question: What is Squadron 42?
items.answer: Squadron 42 is a cinematic single-player space combat game set in the Star Citizen universe. You enlist in the UEE Navy and fight through a story-driven campaign featuring dogfights, boarding actions, and large-scale fleet battles.

items.question: What platforms is Squadron 42 on?
items.answer: Squadron 42 is being developed for PC (Windows) and is planned for release through the official RSI website and Steam.

items.question: Is Squadron 42 the same as Star Citizen?
items.answer: No. Squadron 42 is a standalone single-player campaign set in the same universe as the Star Citizen persistent-universe MMO.

items.question: Does Squadron 42 have active codes?
items.answer: Squadron 42 does not use redeemable codes. Any codes circulating online are not official, so always check the RSI website for accurate information.

items.question: When does Squadron 42 release?
items.answer: Cloud Imperium Games has not announced a final release date. Follow the official RSI website and channel for the latest development updates.
